# dsh-ui-overrides
**Your own CSS for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI — restyle any plugin without patching it.**
`dsh-ui-overrides` serves one user-owned stylesheet and links it into the page. Because every rule i
s plain CSS injected after the plugins' own styles, you can make a floating panel fully opaque, chan
ge colors, fix spacing, or hide an element — for **any** plugin, including ones you did not write.
This is the generalized version of the "quote bar opaque" fix: the stylesheet is yours, so the targe
t is whatever selector you put in it.

## Notes and limits
- **CSS only.** The plugin does not run JavaScript written by users; it links a stylesheet. It canno

t add behavior.
- **Selectors are someone else's contract.** If the target plugin changes its DOM in
an update, the rule may stop matching; update the selector. Prefer `id` / `data-*` selectors over h

ashed class names.
- **Local file, no network.** The stylesheet is served by the DSH host from your

own machine; nothing is uploaded anywhere.
- **Theme-aware colors.** `Canvas` and other CSS system c

olors follow the active light/dark `color-scheme`, so one rule can work in both themes.
- Requires a
Web UI profile (desktop or web). Headless/TUI profiles do not load the client half.
## Compatibility

- Tested with DSH Desktop `0.2.1-rc.2` (`desktop` profile).
- Works with any plugin that renders DOM

in the Web UI; the bundled example targets `dsh-client-ui-quote` 0.12.x.
- `dsh` field: `bundle` +
`client` manifests, installable with `dsh plugin add`.
